deviations_decided_check.name: deviations_decided_check
deviations_decided_check.value: "deviations"."decision" is null or ("deviations"."decided_by_name" is not null and "deviations"."decided_on" is not null)

job_wcrs_signed_check.name: job_wcrs_signed_check
job_wcrs_signed_check.value: ("job_wcrs"."status" = 'signed') = ("job_wcrs"."signed_at" is not null) and ("job_wcrs"."signed_at" is null) = ("job_wcrs"."signed_via" is null) and ("job_wcrs"."signed_via" is null or "job_wcrs"."signed_via" in ('app', 'paper'))

job_wcrs_paper_check.name: job_wcrs_paper_check
job_wcrs_paper_check.value: "job_wcrs"."signed_via" is distinct from 'paper' or ("job_wcrs"."paper_file_id" is not null and "job_wcrs"."paper_signed_by_name" is not null and "job_wcrs"."paper_signed_on" is not null)

payments_amounts_check.name: payments_amounts_check
payments_amounts_check.value: "payments"."reverses_id" is not null or ("payments"."received" >= 0 and "payments"."tds" >= 0 and "payments"."written_off" >= 0 and "payments"."received" + "payments"."tds" + "payments"."written_off" > 0)

equipment_temp_limits_check.name: equipment_temp_limits_check
equipment_temp_limits_check.value: "equipment"."temp_min_c" is null or "equipment"."temp_max_c" is null or "equipment"."temp_min_c" < "equipment"."temp_max_c"

equipment_rh_limits_check.name: equipment_rh_limits_check
equipment_rh_limits_check.value: ("equipment"."rh_min_pct" is null or "equipment"."rh_min_pct" between 0 and 100) and ("equipment"."rh_max_pct" is null or "equipment"."rh_max_pct" between 0 and 100) and ("equipment"."rh_min_pct" is null or "equipment"."rh_max_pct" is null or "equipment"."rh_min_pct" < "equipment"."rh_max_pct")

equipment_counts_check.name: equipment_counts_check
equipment_counts_check.value: ("equipment"."default_channels" is null or "equipment"."default_channels" between 1 and 500) and ("equipment"."reading_interval_minutes" is null or "equipment"."reading_interval_minutes" between 1 and 1440) and ("equipment"."study_duration_hours" is null or "equipment"."study_duration_hours" between 1 and 2160) and ("equipment"."requalification_months" is null or "equipment"."requalification_months" between 1 and 60)

precal_overrides_decision_check.name: precal_overrides_decision_check
precal_overrides_decision_check.value: ("precal_overrides"."status" = 'requested') = ("precal_overrides"."decided_at" is null) and ("precal_overrides"."status" <> 'approved' or "precal_overrides"."signature_id" is not null)

study_positions_xyz_check.name: study_positions_xyz_check
study_positions_xyz_check.value: "study_positions"."x" between 0 and 1 and "study_positions"."y" between 0 and 1 and "study_positions"."z" between 0 and 1

certificates_dates_check.name: certificates_dates_check
certificates_dates_check.value: ("certificates"."valid_until" is null or "certificates"."valid_until" >= "certificates"."calibrated_on") and ("certificates"."calibrated_until" is null or "certificates"."calibrated_until" >= "certificates"."calibrated_on")

jobs_money_check.name: jobs_money_check
jobs_money_check.value: ("jobs"."po_value" is null or "jobs"."po_value" >= 0) and ("jobs"."quoted_value" is null or "jobs"."quoted_value" >= 0)

study_reports_frozen_check.name: study_reports_frozen_check
study_reports_frozen_check.value: ("study_reports"."status" = 'draft') = ("study_reports"."file_id" is null) and ("study_reports"."status" = 'draft') = ("study_reports"."sha256" is null) and ("study_reports"."status" = 'draft') = ("study_reports"."run_id" is null)

study_reports_signed_check.name: study_reports_signed_check
study_reports_signed_check.value: ("study_reports"."signed_at" is null) = ("study_reports"."signed_via" is null) and ("study_reports"."signed_via" is null or "study_reports"."signed_via" in ('app', 'paper'))
